market_definition: The Global Medical Films Market comprises specialized polymer-based films used in medical devices, wound care products, pharmaceutical packaging and healthcare applications. These films are manufactured using materials such as thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU), polyethylene (PE), polypropylene (PP), polyester (PET) and other medical-grade polymers. Key applications include transparent wound dressings, surgical drapes, catheter securement films, NPWT dressing films, medical device components and sterile medical packaging.
